name: A bundle becomes a trap

date.label: Burning Crusade Shadowmoon quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Tobias provides a bundle of bloodthistle for Borak. The plan is to leave it at the far end of the bridge and wait for the envoy to collect it apart from his bodyguard. Borak says blood elves despise Thistleheads; that prejudice is the lever he chooses. The story records a deception and a calculated risk, without claiming every detail of the encounter beyond the quest’s objective.
